method: Three cycles of four CUA-fill queries per viewport;capture-to-bubble input dispatch,actual instrumented source phases,two pre-paint rAF callbacks and Long Animation Frames. Fixed dimensions/document scroll/sidebar height. Visible synthetic guest fixture,no CPU throttle or concurrent project test run during final measurements. All rows retained;not field INP or presentation timing.
limitations: Small local sample on one desktop engine,uncontrolled background system load,no production field percentiles or real mobile-device claim.
CUA fill events are untrusted. rAF precedes paint;LoAF excludes presentation. Values include the declared fixture/probe overhead.
No standalone reduction of DOM count:all454 rows remain. No loading/network/selection speedup claimed.
Real screen reader,MIDI,physical playing,audio quality and private account data not exercised.
Earlier profiles before focus/selected-row corrections and failed fixture bootstrap are retained outside the final comparison.
